meta.title: Notifier
meta.description: Task-event notifications for dsh web via browser Notification and host system toast, with Bark and webhook push channels.

en.channelsDomainHint: Saves channel changes only; other unsaved edits stay untouched
en.chBarkBaseUrlHint: Bark server URL (http/https), e.g. https://api.day.app or self-hosted
en.chBarkDeviceKeyHint: Find it in the Bark app; leave empty to keep the saved value, type a new one to replace it
en.chBarkDeviceKeyPlaceholder: Paste the Device Key from the Bark app
en.chBarkGroupHint: Notifications of the same group collapse on the phone
en.chBarkIconHint: Image URL reachable from the phone; SVG needs iOS 17+; empty uses Bark default
en.chBarkLevelHint: Instance-level urgency (auto-mapped from event severity when unset); a matching row in "Per-type level map" below wins over this
en.chLevelsEmpty: No per-type mapping (all events use the default level)
en.chLevelsHint: Set a Bark urgency per event type; takes precedence over the default level and auto-mapping. Types without a row use the default
en.chLevelsUnknown: Unknown event type (may not take effect — check the spelling)
en.chPopupSoundOffNote: Popup and sound are both off: this channel shows nothing (use the header switch to disable it — the switch is the only send/don't-send gate).
en.chSoundFollowHint: System card: Windows uses the toast system sound / macOS Glass / Linux self-plays the default event sound; browser card: lets the OS play (not silent).
en.chSoundOnlyNote: Popup off, sound on: this channel plays sound only (no popup).
en.chTestDraftTitle: Deliver once with the current unsaved draft (nothing is saved or persisted)
en.conflictChannels: Channel configuration was changed in another window:
en.conflictReloadFail: Conflict recovery failed: could not fetch the latest config — retry saving
en.diagBrowserAudioAutoSuspended: the audio context is suspended by the browser: it was unlocked before, or this resume was refused; the next user interaction retries
en.diagBrowserAudioClosed: the audio context is closed; this page cannot self-play sounds for the rest of its lifetime
en.diagBrowserAudioNeverUnlocked: audio is not unlocked yet: the page has not seen a user click; a click enables self-playback
en.diagBrowserAudioUnsupported: this browser does not support Web Audio, so the plugin cannot self-play sounds
en.diagBrowserInsecureContext: insecure context (plain HTTP), the browser blocks system popups
en.diagBrowserNoNotificationApi: this browser has no notification API, so system popups are unavailable
en.diagBrowserPermissionDefault: Without permission, browser system notifications cannot appear; while the page is hidden, only the title is updated. When the page is visible, an in-page banner appears only if the notification policy allows it. Permission has not been requested; click "Request permission" to grant it
en.diagBrowserPermissionDenied: Without permission, browser system notifications cannot appear; while the page is hidden, only the title is updated. When the page is visible, an in-page banner appears only if the notification policy allows it. Permission was denied; allow it in the browser site settings
en.diagRemediationUnknown: The host reported a fix this client version does not recognize; update the plugin and retry
en.diagRemHostManagedByOthers: Popup and sound are already handled by other components on the host: this plugin's system channel silently skips on this machine, so use browser notifications or mobile push instead
en.diagRemHostNoDbusSession: The host has no D-Bus session bus: system popups need a desktop session (graphical login) or a session bus from dbus-launch
en.diagRemHostNoNotifySend: The host is missing notify-send: install a notification tool that provides it (libnotify-bin on Debian/Ubuntu, libnotify on Fedora/Arch) and popups become visible
en.diagRemHostNoPlayer: The host has a sound server but no player: install a matching player to play the default event sound
en.diagRemHostNoSoundServerAndPlayer: The host exposed no usable player: install {packages} ({packagemanager}) to self-play the default event sound (on dnf-family hosts ffmpeg comes from RPM Fusion)
en.diagRemHostNoSoundServerAndPlayerNoPkg: The host exposed no usable player: install a player that does not need a sound server (e.g. alsa-utils or ffmpeg) to self-play the default event sound
en.diagRemHostNoToneFile: The host is missing the default event sound file: provide this platform's sound resources to self-play it (on Linux a missing theme now falls back to a synthesized tone, so this advice no longer applies there)
en.diagRemHostOnlySoundServerPlayers: The host only exposed sound-server players (paplay / pw-play): install {packages} ({packagemanager}) to self-play the default event sound straight through ALSA (on dnf-family hosts ffmpeg comes from RPM Fusion)
en.diagRemHostOnlySoundServerPlayersNoPkg: The host only exposed sound-server players (paplay / pw-play): install a player that does not need a sound server (e.g. alsa-utils or ffmpeg) to self-play the default event sound straight through ALSA
en.diagRemHostPopupNoDaemon: The host has notify-send but no notification daemon: install and start a desktop notification service (e.g. dunst, mako) for popups to appear
en.diagSourceBrowser: Source: judged locally in this browser page
en.diagSourceHost: Source: host capability self-check (GET /api/dsh-notifier/diagnostics, the machine running the server)
en.diagUnknownLine: These capabilities could not be determined: {dimensions}
en.dirtyDomains: Events and channels both have unsaved changes
en.dndEmptyHint: No windows: do-not-disturb will not suppress anything
en.dndPreviewMiss: Now {now} is outside the do-not-disturb windows
en.dndPreviewNote: Estimated from this device clock, for reference only; actual suppression follows the server verdict and history
en.dryRunNote: Draft test: tests the current draft only; nothing is saved and no history or status is recorded; the browser channel does not really notify — this row is the verdict; repeated clicks send repeatedly; if the peer actually received a timed-out test, it will not appear in history or status.
en.evtTurnEndHint: Turn completions fire every turn and are very frequent, so this stays off by default; once enabled, they may sit next to Task completed notifications; delivering to multiple channels reminds once per channel (still subject to throttling and routing).
en.historyEmpty: No history yet (click "Send test notification" to create one)
en.httpDegraded: You are on a LAN HTTP connection (insecure context) — the browser blocks system notifications; in-page banner + sound + title reminders are active instead. For system notifications, use dsh-lan-proxy https://<LAN-IP>:3443 or a localhost tunnel (e.g. ssh -L 3080:127.0.0.1:3080), then refresh.
en.iosUnsupported: This device does not support system notifications (e.g. iOS Safari in a normal tab). Available channels: in-page banner + sound while the page is open, or PWA-grade notifications via dsh-lan-proxy https://<LAN-IP>:3443 with "Add to Home Screen".
en.kindsHint: Types registered by other plugins are delivered only after your confirmation
en.lanAccessHint: (If you are on a LAN connection: the notify service only accepts loopback calls — open via dsh-lan-proxy https://<LAN-IP>:3443 or an ssh -L 3080:127.0.0.1:3080 tunnel, then refresh)
en.permDefault: Browser notification permission: not granted. Without permission, browser system notifications cannot appear; while the page is hidden, only the title is updated. When the page is visible, an in-page banner appears only if the notification policy allows it. Click the button below to request permission.
en.permDenied: Browser notification permission: denied. Without permission, browser system notifications cannot appear; while the page is hidden, only the title is updated. When the page is visible, an in-page banner appears only if the notification policy allows it. Allow notifications for this site in the browser site settings.
en.reasonBarkBodyUnreadable: Could not read the Bark response body (the push may have gone through)
en.reasonChannelThrew: Delivery channel raised an internal error
en.reasonDispatchCanceled: Still queued when the plugin was unloaded; not delivered
en.reasonSkipConfig: Popup and sound are both off — nothing to deliver this time
en.reasonSkipEnvironment: No usable notification channel on this host (no system notifier or audio player); nothing was sent
en.reasonSystemToastScriptMissing: The plugin's bundled Windows notification script is missing (packaging defect); nothing was sent
en.reasonSystemToneUnwritable: Could not write the synthesized tone to the temp directory; nothing was played
en.reasonThrottled: Less than 1s since the previous one; not delivered (see the previous record)
en.reasonWebhookTemplateInvalid: Webhook template rendering failed (template is not valid JSON)
en.routeCustomStateTitle: Route customized (frozen snapshot); click to reset to default
en.routeDefaultStateTitle: Not customized: delivered to all enabled channels (dynamic as channels toggle)
en.routeDisabledHint: Channel not enabled: enable it under Notify channels first to configure delivery
en.routeStaleTitle: This channel was deleted but its route entry remains; skipped at delivery (the stale entry is not removed automatically)
en.saveTimeout: Save timed out: request did not complete within 15s, please retry
en.settingsSvcDown: Settings service unavailable: cannot save configuration (settings service not mounted). Plugin notifications are unaffected, but changes will be rejected.
en.soundWarnNoPlayback: Could not play the sound (no usable player or audio material; only the popup succeeded)
en.soundWarnToneUnwritable: Could not prepare the sound (temp file unwritable; only the popup succeeded)
en.sysPlatformLinux: Host platform Linux: does not rely on desktop daemon sound support — the plugin self-plays, falling back through paplay → pw-play → aplay → ffplay and stopping at the first success; when the themed event sound is missing it uses a tone synthesized at runtime. When only paplay/pw-play are found, a host without a sound server stays silent (both cases still need an audio device on the host).
en.sysPlatformMac: Host platform macOS: system sound goes through osascript/NSSound (Glass/Tink/Sosumi/Pop approximate mapping), subject to the system "Allow notification sounds" setting.
en.sysPlatformOther: System sound is best-effort on the host platform; the preview here is synthesized locally in your browser as a listening reference.
en.sysPlatformWin: Host platform Windows: system sound uses the toast default; with a tone selected it plays a built-in wav via SoundPlayer (approximate mapping, may differ from system-settings sounds).
en.testChannelOk: Test accepted (the delivery result appears under "History")
en.testSent: Test notification sent ({n} unreleased server handles)
en.whAuthHint: Credentials go in request headers only (ntfy / Gotify both support the Authorization header), never in the URL; stored locally and shown masked; leave empty to keep the saved value
en.whPresetHint: Preset fills the auth method and message template; ntfy publishes to the service root URL (legacy topic URLs are auto-rewritten)
en.whTemplate: Message template (JSON body, click to insert placeholders)
en.whTemplateFailHint: Invalid template or render failure counts as a failed delivery for this channel only; other channels are unaffected
en.whTemplateHint: ntfy publishes to the service root URL with the real topic in the template; {{priority}} is rendered by the server per-channel map (ntfy numbers: info→3 / success→2 / warning→4 / failure→5; gotify keeps its existing map); text placeholders are JSON-aware escaped, {{ts}} is raw number
en.whTimeoutHint: seconds · 1–60 (clamped, default 10); timeouts and failures are recorded, no auto-retry
en.whUrlHint: POST JSON; ntfy publishes to the service root URL with the real topic in the template, legacy topic URLs are auto-compat (rewritten to the root when the trailing segment is unambiguous), and self-hosted prefixed roots are kept as-is; http(s) only, no embedded credentials in the URL; add a random suffix to ntfy topic names
en.whUrlPlaceholder: https://ntfy.sh/ (put the topic in the template)
